name: Wall-to-wall bookcase with a radiator cover, East Finchley (standard sizes)
source: Built in Trimble SketchUp through the connector (9 Oct 2026) from the job photos at standard sizes (nothing measured): 3200 wall to wall and 2600 high, three bays (948, 1232 and 948 between 18 mm uprights). Base 800 high and 400 deep with a 25 mm top running wall to wall; upper shelves 300 deep, four 25 mm shelves in each bay; 70 mm pilasters and a 120 mm top rail on the front; MDF backs (the middle bay's back stops at the base top so the radiator sits against the wall). Side bays: two doors each with an applied square moulding, a shelf inside, recessed plinth. Middle bay: the radiator cover, two doors with an 80 mm MDF frame round a white diamond grille. Back and side walls and the radiator are room context. No dimension lines. Read back face by face; units mm, X along the wall, Y out from the room, Z up.
